Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) – Bullion Portfolio Trading LLC

1. About Bullion Portfolio Trading (BPT)

We are a family-run business with German roots and over 25 years of experience in precious metals trading. Under the leadership of Carolin Schwarz, we carry on the expertise of Henry Schwarz (founder of GfM / Anlagegold24 in Germany) in the United Arab Emirates. We combine German precision with the global reach of our location in Dubai.

Yes, we are registered as a “Dealer in Precious Metals and Stones” (DPMS) with the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) under license number 1477000. We are subject to the supervision of the UAE Ministry of Economy.

2. Ordering & Payment

Orders can be placed directly through our online shop at www.bpt-shop.ae, as well as manually via email at sales@bpt-shop.ae or via WhatsApp at +971 58 599 8412. Please note that prices are fixed in real time due to financial market fluctuations, and the order is therefore legally binding.

To ensure maximum security, we accept payments exclusively via prepayment (bank transfer). The payment must be made from a bank account in the buyer’s name.

In accordance with our Terms and Conditions and the legal provisions governing the trade in precious metals, there is no right of withdrawal, as the prices of the goods are subject to fluctuations in the financial markets over which we have no control. “All sales are final.”

3. Shipping & Delivery

Currently, our delivery area is limited exclusively to the city of Dubai (UAE). Deliveries to other emirates or international destinations are only available upon individual request.

Security is our top priority. We work with Loomis International, a leading global security logistics provider. Every shipment is insured against loss and theft up to a value of $15 million.

Yes, we offer a “Window Collection” service at the Gold Souk in Dubai, which is also handled by our partner Loomis International. This requires a prior appointment and a physical identity check (Emirates ID).

To ensure maximum security and comply with AML regulations, we adhere to the principle of personal identity:

  • Identification: Only the person who placed the order may receive the goods. Delivery to authorized third parties is not permitted.
  • Payment: Payment must be made from a bank account held in the name of the person placing the order.
  • Verification: At the time of delivery or pickup, you must present the same physical Emirates ID used during the KYC process. If the names of the person placing the order, the account holder, and the recipient do not match, the goods cannot be handed over.

The physical presentation of the Emirates ID is a mandatory part of our security and KYC protocol. Our logistics partner, Loomis, may only hand over the goods if the recipient’s identity matches the data provided during the order without a doubt.

Since we ship high-value precious metals, personal delivery with identity verification (Emirates ID) is mandatory. If a delivery fails – for example, due to absence or refusal to provide identification – the goods will be returned to Loomis International’s high-security vault for your safety.

Please note: In this case, additional costs will be incurred for return shipping and secure temporary storage. A new delivery attempt can be arranged on a case-by-case basis, but will only be carried out after full payment of the additional costs incurred, as well as the fees for the new delivery attempt.

Despite our strict security measures, you are protected: Please inspect the package for damage immediately upon delivery. If a seal is broken, note this directly on the delivery receipt. Hidden damage must be reported to us within 48 hours using our complaint form (LINK).

No, for security reasons and due to the required personal identity verification (Emirates ID), delivery to P.O. Boxes is not permitted. We deliver exclusively to physical addresses within Dubai.

4. AML & Compliance, Documentation & Source of Funds

No, to comply with the UAE’s strict AML (Anti-Money Laundering) regulations and international standards, we conduct an identity verification (KYC) for every customer. This serves to ensure the security of Dubai’s legal financial center and protects you as an honest buyer.

As a registered precious metals dealer (DPMS), we are subject to the UAE’s strict AML (Anti-Money Laundering) laws. We use iDenfy to conduct a secure and fast digital identity verification (KYC). This protects both you, as a customer, from identity theft and us from fraud.

For transactions that reach or exceed the threshold of 55,000 AED, we are legally required to verify the source of funds. This can be done through pay stubs, bank statements, or sales documents.

To ensuTo comply with UAEFIU requirements, we accept current pay stubs from the last three months, bank statements that clearly show the accumulation of savings, as well as notarized gift agreements or proof of inheritance.

In accordance with UAE AML regulations, we are required to monitor multiple partial payments from the same customer. If these payments collectively reach the threshold of 55,000 AED, the same compliance checks (KYC & Source of Funds) apply as for a single transaction.

5. Business Clients & B2B (Corporate Clients)

No, to comply with the UAE’s strict AML (Anti-Money Laundering) regulations and international standards, we conduct an identity verification (KYC) for every customer. This serves to ensure the security of Dubai’s legal financial center and protects you as an honest buyer.

Yes, we assist corporate clients in diversifying their portfolios with physical precious metals. However, due to the strict regulatory requirements in the UAE (Compliance & KYB), specific conditions must be met.

To successfully complete the transaction, three identities must match:

  1. The Ordering Party: The person placing the order in the shop must be an authorized representative or have been granted power of attorney and must complete the digital KYC process (iDenfy).
  2. The Payer: Payment must be made from a corporate account in the name of the ordering company. Personal transfers from company executives on behalf of the company are not permitted.
  3. The Recipient: The goods will only be handed over to the authorized representative, who is also the purchaser, upon presentation of their physical Emirates ID at the time of delivery.

In addition to the representative’s identity verification, we require:

  • A copy of the current Trade License (Certificate of Incorporation).
  • The document detailing the shareholder structure (Shareholder Registry / Memorandum of Association).
  • Information on the ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs).

As with private individuals, the threshold of 55,000 AED (or for linked transactions) also applies to companies. In this case, we require business documentation, such as current annual financial statements, a bank statement, or evidence of a capital increase, to verify the source of the investment amount to the UAEFIU (Financial Intelligence Unit).

Yes, while investment gold and silver (purity ≥ 99% / 99.9%) are VAT-exempt in the UAE, services such as insured delivery by Loomis are subject to the statutory 5% VAT. This will be listed separately on your company invoice, including our TRN (104908170400003).

6. Data Protection & Security in the Webshop

For us, security starts with our IT infrastructure. Our servers are located in Switzerland to benefit from the world’s highest security and data protection standards. All data transfers are encrypted, and we conduct regular security audits.

Your data is protected in accordance with UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 (PDPL). While our headquarters are in Dubai, we use an IT infrastructure in Switzerland to benefit from the extremely high security standards there.

In accordance with UAE AML laws, we are required to securely archive transaction records and identity documents for at least five (5) years after the business relationship ends.

7. Storage & Flexibility

Yes, we offer our customers two first-class solutions for different needs:

  • Vintage Vaults (Mall of the Emirates): Ideal for customers who need physical access to their valuables in a private safe deposit box at any time (10:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.). Maximum discretion thanks to a two-key system and a direct connection to the Dubai Police.
  • Loomis International: Specialized in the long-term institutional storage of larger holdings in a high-security customs-bonded warehouse.

This solution is specifically designed for the secure storage of extensive precious metal portfolios. Your assets are stored in a government-monitored customs-bonded warehouse with 24-hour surveillance and state-of-the-art security technology. Immediately after purchase in the BPT-Shop, the goods are transferred directly to the secure vault. While this high-security solution does not include an in-person visit (inspection), physical delivery from the vault or the sale of your holdings is possible at any time without issue.

Vintage Vaults offers security standards that far exceed those of traditional banking. In addition to insurance through Lloyd’s of London and monitoring by the Dubai Police, you enjoy complete privacy here. Unlike banks, you have access to your valuables until midnight, even on weekends and holidays.

Yes, we offer our customers full flexibility and liquidity for the products purchased from us. If your assets are stored with Loomis, we are happy to assist you at any time with the sale or rebalancing of your portfolio.

8. Value-Added Tax (VAT), Fees & Legal Information

No, as long as the items are investment grade (in the form of bars or coins). Under UAE law, investment gold with a purity of at least 99% and investment silver with a purity of at least 99.9% are exempt from VAT. As a registered dealer with a valid Tax Registration Number (TRN: 104908170400003), we process these qualifying transactions tax-free.

Please note: Products that are not classified as investment grade or have a lower purity, as well as services (e.g., delivery fees or handling charges from Loomis International), are subject to a 5% value-added tax (VAT). This will be listed separately on your invoice.

All contracts and any resulting legal disputes are governed exclusively by the laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the federal laws of the United Arab Emirates. The exclusive place of jurisdiction for all transactions is Dubai, UAE. The provisions of the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG) do not apply.

9. Dubai Gold Market & Location Advantages

Dubai is known worldwide as one of the safest and most efficient trading hubs for precious metals. Thanks to the strict controls of the UAE Ministry of Economy and the tax advantages (0% VAT on investment gold and silver), Dubai offers significant price advantages and the highest level of discretion compared to Europe..

Not only gold, but also investment-grade silver with a purity of at least 99.9% can be purchased VAT-free in Dubai. This is a significant locational advantage over many European countries, where silver is often subject to full VAT or differential taxation. At BPT, we leverage this advantage directly in our pricing.

In addition to tax exemption (0% VAT on investment-grade assets), Dubai benefits from its geographic location and its role as a global trade hub. The high trading volumes and efficient infrastructure at the “Gold Souk” and in “Business Bay” enable tighter spreads (the difference between the buy and sell prices), which we pass on to our clients.

Yes, Dubai is considered one of the safest places in the world for tangible assets. The combination of political stability, extremely low crime rates, and a state-of-the-art security infrastructure (such as our partners’ direct connection to the Dubai Police) makes the emirate the ideal vault for international investors.

10. Authenticity Guarantee, Quality, Purity, and LBMA Certification

Yes, as an official distributor of leading mints, we offer only high-quality precious metals. Our product range includes:

  • LBMA-certified bars: We carry only investment bars from manufacturers listed on the London Bullion Market Association (LBMA) “Good Delivery List.” This guarantees the highest level of acceptance worldwide and hassle-free resale.
  • Globally recognized bullion coins: We offer classics such as the Maple Leaf, Krugerrand, Britannia, Vienna Philharmonic, Australian Kangaroo, and many more.
  • German quality standards: Through our partnership with long-established companies such as Heimerle + Meule (Germany’s oldest gold and silver refinery), we guarantee purity and excellence in accordance with the highest European standards.

Every product that leaves our facility undergoes rigorous quality control. Bullion bars are delivered in their original, tamper-proof blister packaging (CertiCard), which includes an integrated certificate of authenticity and a unique serial number. For coins, we guarantee government minting and the full fineness of the respective mint (e.g., Royal Canadian Mint).

We offer exclusive collector coins, which are often delivered in an elegant box including a numbered certificate of authenticity from the respective mint.

The term “Investment Grade” refers to precious metals that are officially recognized as investment assets. In the United Arab Emirates (UAE), this is the legal requirement for VAT-free (0% VAT) purchases.

According to the legal provisions in Dubai, for gold or silver to be considered an “Investment Precious Metal,” the following minimum requirements must be met by law:

  1. Purity: Gold must have a fineness of at least 99% (990/1000) and silver of at least 99.9% (999/1000).
  2. Form: The metal must be in the form of bars or coins that are tradable on international markets. Jewelry or industrial metals do not qualify for this tax exemption.
  3. Trading standard: Products must come from certified manufacturers (e.g., LBMA standard).

We place the highest value on quality and value retention. To guarantee our customers “German precision,” we adhere to the highest standards:

  • Primary product range (fine gold & fine silver): We primarily carry products with the highest fineness of 999.9/1000 (24 karat for gold). These products are considered “investment grade” and are completely VAT-exempt within Dubai (0% VAT).
  • Disclosure of deviations: If we carry products whose fineness falls below the legal thresholds for tax exemption, we clearly indicate this in the shop.
  • Tax Note: Please note that products that do not meet the legal minimum requirements for investment-grade precious metals (99% for gold / 99.9% for silver) are subject to the statutory 5% VAT. This will be clearly displayed in your shopping cart.

Thanks to this clear labeling, when you shop at Bullion Portfolio Trading LLC, you always do so with full transparency regarding quality and tax status.

11. Product Range & Investment

Yes, thanks to our close ties to Germany, we carry high-quality products from renowned manufacturers such as Heimerle + Meule. The innovative UnityBoxes for silver investments are particularly popular here.

Yes, our prices are linked to the live rates of international precious metals exchanges and update every 2 minutes. As soon as you add a product to your cart and complete the checkout process, the price is temporarily locked in for you to protect you from price fluctuations during payment.

Yes, in addition to gold, we carry an extensive range of physical silver investments of the highest quality (999.9/1000). Our highlights include the latest official issue of the Silver Maple Leaf, as well as other globally recognized international classics such as the Krugerrand and the Britannia. The Silver Maple Leaf, one of the world’s most secure investment coins, features state-of-the-art security measures against counterfeiting.
Additionally, as part of our partnership with Heimerle + Meule, we offer the classic 1 kg silver bar, which is considered the ideal standard for larger holdings and is certified by Germany’s oldest gold and silver refinery. You can also invest with particular flexibility using our 100 x 1-gram UnityBoxes. This innovative solution allows you to remove the 1-gram bars individually, making them perfect for crisis protection or as a high-quality gift.

Yes, in addition to trading standard investment products, we are your partner for custom minting solutions. As specialists in medals and custom-made items, we combine German craftsmanship with state-of-the-art technology. Please feel free to contact us about your custom project.

12. The BPT Excellence Portfolio: Uniqueness for Top Investors

In a market often dominated by standard products, we redefine the limits of what is possible. Our ability to provide access to items that are difficult or impossible to obtain on the regular market sets us apart from competitors worldwide. We see ourselves not merely as dealers, but as strategic partners for top-tier investors who view physical assets as the ultimate form of wealth preservation and a status symbol.

The most striking example of our unique position is the 100 kg Big Maple Leaf. While other dealers trade standard ounces, we offer a monument of the purest gold (999.9/1000), of which only 10 pieces exist worldwide in an extremely limited total edition. We can currently have 3 more of these produced and offer them exclusively to our customers. This makes it not only an extraordinary gold investment, but also a historic collector’s item and a symbol of the highest financial sovereignty.

The 100 kg Big Maple Leaf is one of the world’s most prestigious collector’s items and reflects our access to the most exclusive precious metal reserves worldwide, which are usually off-limits to the regular market. It is made of the purest gold (999.9/1000) and is a symbol of absolute rarity and craftsmanship.

We are in the privileged position of being able to offer this extraordinary investment to a total of three exclusive clients worldwide. Consultation and execution for assets of this magnitude are handled with the utmost discretion through our specialized channels for high-net-worth individuals to guarantee maximum security and absolute confidentiality.

If you would like to secure one of these three exclusive specimens for your portfolio, please contact us directly for a confidential consultation at sales@bpt-shop.ae or +971 58 599 8412.

Do you have further questions? We’re here for you!

These FAQs serve as a guide and are continuously updated by us. If you can’t find the information you’re looking for or have a specific question about a product or your individual portfolio, please don’t hesitate to contact us directly.

Your feedback is important to us: We constantly update our FAQs based on your inquiries to provide you with the best possible service and maximum transparency. We are very grateful for your support and trust.

You can reach us at any time:

  • Email: sales@bpt-shop.ae
  • WhatsApp: +971 58 599 8412
  • In person: We would also be happy to meet with you in person at our office in Business Bay, Dubai, by appointment.
